title: Validate rent amount is positive
gherkin:
Feature: Rent Validation
  Scenario: Rent amount must be positive
    Given a rental agreement is being created
    When the rent amount is set to a negative value
    Then the system should reject the rent amount
    And display an error message indicating rent must be positive
rationale: Rent amounts cannot be negative or zero as they represent payment obligations. This is a fundamental validation rule for any rental system.
